privacy_forms_draft.flow: Android computes a signature locally and sends signature, excerpt duration and timing to the unofficial Shazam endpoint on user-started recognition. Raw PCM and audio files are not sent by that request. Request UUIDs are newly generated, not a stored device identifier. No location permission or measured coordinates are used.

privacy_forms_draft.declaration: Review optional app-functionality collection and user-initiated transfer exceptions against provider practices. The draft is not a completed or submitted Data safety form.

phone_checklist: After a full phone reboot, wait for normal system readiness, then record first launch, a force-stopped relaunch, visible UI-ready time and any ANR. Repeat without background downloads. Report exact phone model/OS.
Tune every string with deliberate sharp/flat offsets, then let it decay. Check octave stability.
Run tuner for 10 minutes including sustained voice; switch guitar/chromatic and selected octaves.
Lock/unlock, background/return and interrupt audio. Check recovery and microphone release.
Listen to slow/fast rhythms, rapidly switch previews, verify up/down pattern and F/E chords without clicks.
Preview different fingerings and use capo/transposition; compare sounding pitches with diagrams.
Create/edit a song with cover, restart, verify favorites and reading/rhythm settings.
Export backup, preview/restore, verify covers and settings; cancellation must preserve existing data.
Record while auto-scrolling; replay/export/delete. Check loud and quiet performances. Recordings are not in library backup.
Deny microphone permission, then enable it in device settings. Test offline mode.
Check portrait/landscape, large text and keyboard on a small phone. No overlap or unreachable controls.
When accounts exist, verify purchases, cancellation, pending state and recovery through store sandbox.

Recognize an international song; verify artist/title identity, complete lyrics/chords when available, apostrophes/remaster suffixes, retry after cancellation, a healthy no-match, airplane mode and blocked/slow providers. Never replace reviewed text with a late response.

outstanding.action: Publish docs/privacy.html at a stable public HTTPS URL controlled by the developer, provide a support page and enter both URLs in store metadata. No URL is invented.
On macOS install pods, select signing team, build/archive, verify Privacy Report/SDK manifests and run test-ios-pitch.py plus microphone/recording tests.
Register identifier com.freetune or change identifiers consistently if unavailable. Configure consumable freetune_support, taxes, pricing and tester access.
Capture final device screens, review data-safety/age-rating/rights answers. Do not submit preview collages as genuine device screenshots.

Verify provider availability, automated-access/content permissions and privacy disclosures before publication. The unofficial Shazam endpoint has no contractual availability guarantee. Do not claim that every song has lyrics or chords.
